title: ever CODI|Bow Straps Floral Lace Tiered Dress
descriptionHtml:
This enchanting dress features delicate bow straps and a beautiful floral lace overlay, making it perfect for weddings and special events. The tiered design adds a playful flair, enhancing movement while maintaining elegance. With its flattering silhouette, this piece is designed to make any guest feel stunning. Pair it with strappy heels and minimal accessories for a chic look that stands out.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Tea-Length


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back


Undergarments:It is Padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises Lace.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.

Occasion: Graduation, Homecoming, Bridesmaid, Wedding Guest, Party
